speech.heard: Moldova's urban population shrinks by 1.3% a year, while Rwanda's grows by 5.6%. Urban growth is slower in major economies, USA has 0.6% and UK has 0.4%. Africa dominates the fastest growth, Chad has 5.7%, Rwanda has 5.6% and Niger has 5%. The city leads the world at 5.8%. That is 14 times the UK rate. At the other end, Japan sees its cities shrinking by 0.4% a year. Is your city's population growing or shrinking?
